scope: RZ and RSPHERE Esirkepov Langmuir resolution families; independent geometry fits only

design.fit_interval: all adjacent pairs from the declared 64/128/256 levels; no post-hoc omission
design.repeat_requirement: A second independently produced family with the same declared physics and observable contract is required before formal-order closure.

observables.rule: Primary and secondary observables are reported separately; no universal order or geometry pooling is permitted.

controls.negative_control: correction=off is reported as a control and cannot be used to repair or select the correction=on fit interval
controls.axis_boundary: axis and off-axis charge residuals remain separate; axis residual is not replaced by all-cell residual

closure_gates: all declared levels and adjacent refinement ratios are present
all primary and secondary observables are finite at every level
both independent families per geometry are present
all adjacent pairwise slopes are computed without selective omission
repeat-family slopes remain within the preregistered comparison tolerance
the result is still reported separately for RZ and RSPHERE
formal closure does not imply default axis-charge correctness unless the independent charge gate also passes

blocking_gates: only one independent family is currently materialized per geometry
correction-on axis charge remains a boundary in the source contracts
field and charge slopes are descriptive and are not yet repeat-validated
